coreCommittees.name: Publicity Committee
coreCommittees.description: Handles fest teasers, public relations, and branding.

verticals.name: AI Creator's Lab
verticals.description: Where creativity meets intelligence! From building smart chatbots to designing websites, posters, and storytelling tools, this lab is your space to experiment with the magic of generative AI.

verticals.name: GameNova
verticals.description: For those who live to play and dream to create! GameNova is all about building games, hosting e-sports tournaments, and turning gaming passion into real experiences.

verticals.name: FIELDOPS
verticals.description: The energy hub of Labyrinth! FIELDOPS organizes matches, leads teams, and represents the department in sports, building team spirit both on and off the ground.

verticals.name: CROSSCODE
verticals.description: Breaking barriers between branches! CROSSCODE helps non-CS students dive into tech through events, mentorship, and collaborations—because innovation has no boundaries.

verticals.name: THE ROUNDTABLE
verticals.description: Speak smart, think sharp! THE ROUNDTABLE is for debates, discussions, and idea battles where logic, voice, and confidence take center stage.

verticals.name: CODECRAFT
verticals.description: Think. Code. Conquer. CODECRAFT is the arena for competitive programming, hackathons, and problem-solving challenges that sharpen your coding skills.

verticals.name: THE AESTHETIC LAB
verticals.description: The vibe-makers of Labyrinth! From media, design, and content to event branding and coordination, this vertical ensures creativity powers every move.

verticals.name: STARTOVATE
verticals.description: Dream. Build. Lead. STARTOVATE inspires startup culture, innovation talks, and trend-spotting sessions—where business ideas meet tech minds.

verticals.name: CIPHERGUARD
verticals.description: Step into the digital battlefield! CIPHERGUARD trains you in ethical hacking, system security, and CTFs to defend and outsmart cyber threats.

verticals.name: BITOPS
verticals.description: From terminals to cloud, BITOPS is where code comes alive. Explore Linux, scripting, deployment tools, and CI/CD—taking projects from local to live!
